game.name: Lego Harry Potter: Years 5–7 (Russia)(En,Pl,Ru)
game.desc: Lego Harry Potter: Years 5 to 7 on Xbox 360 is an action/adventure game that lets you relive the adventures of the young wizard Harry Potter. Swing various spells to progress through the scenario of the last three films and collect a host of bonuses of all kinds, both in solo and in cooperation.
